rules.statement: A presumption that a will is destroyed by the testator can be rebutted if there is evidence that the will was available at the time of the testator's death.
rules.supporting_quote: However, this is a rebuttable presumption- vide Manchihamy v Abeyasekera 15 N L R 479, Attapattu v Jayawardene 22 N L R 497, Rosaline Nona v Mango Nona 66 N L R 33.
